name: Wrenlet · Gremlet #39
description:
A round little wren with its tail cocked high. Sings far too loudly for its size.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Wrenlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
